lines.en: My bulk scrapes through the treetops.
Each step sinks the ground.
I shift toward where the people are.
My vast body crushes the shrubs.
I do not know what going around means.

lines.zh: 我踩着被压塌的路前进
lines.en: I advance on a road I flatten myself.
Joints shift inside my body.

lines.zh: 我抬头,嗅到村子的味道
lines.en: I lift my head and scent a village.

lines.zh: 泥土在我脚下变成湿浆
lines.en: The soil turns to wet slurry under me.

lines.zh: 我一步步走得很慢,但不停
lines.en: I move slowly, but never stop.

lines.zh: 我停住,整片林子都静了
lines.en: I halt, and the whole wood goes still.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸像远处的潮声
lines.en: My breathing sounds like a distant tide.
Something inside me is rearranging.
I tilt my head as if hearing the tide.
My trunk splits open and closes.
I raise my enormous forelimb.
This grove is too small for me.
I turn my head slowly.
Seawater drips from my body.
The trees below bend under me.

lines.zh: 我在等体内的声音说完
lines.en: I wait for the voice inside to finish.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住半片空地
lines.en: My shadow covers half the clearing.
A part of me is burning hot.
I brace myself on my forelimbs.

lines.zh: 骨头在我体内咔咔作响
lines.en: My bones rattle inside me.
Standing like this counts as rest.
You are at my feet, like a stone.
I lower my head to look at you.
So small a thing, and it moves.
I have made out your shape.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候,我在看你
lines.en: While you look up, I am looking at you.
Your scent is clear.
I tilt my head as if judging.
You did not run; that is rare.
I lift a forelimb, then set it down.
Neither of us need hurry.
This ground is mine now.
Your village lies that way, does it not?
Something has cut my hide.
I pause here a moment.
This will grow back.

lines.zh: 我退回半步,树又断了几根
lines.en: I fall back half a step; more trees snap.
Something inside me is struggling.
My bulk trembles.
You struck something vital.
The tide aches on my behalf.
I lift my head and straighten again.
This body still remembers pain.
That smell is fresh.
I tilt my head your way.
Something inside me is hungry.
I extend one long limb.
That is not a mouthful for me.
I lower my head and come close.
What you hold is warm.
I smell it better than you do.
I lean a little more your way.
Do not put it away yet.
You hit me as if hitting a wall.
My bulk does not move.
I lower my head and see you clearly.
That force is truly not enough.
You are shoved back off your feet.
My hide is thicker than bark.
Do not stand in my path.
I shift my weight.
The ground sinks further under me.
Go around me on the side.

lines.zh: 我们这种躯体,不谈温柔
lines.en: Bodies like ours do not speak of gentleness.
I lean close, and trees snap.
The voice inside answers.
We head for the shore together.
You need not fear my size.
I lower a forelimb for you.
The tide will remember us.

lines.zh: 这片林子容不下两个我
lines.en: This wood cannot hold two of me.
Walk slowly; do not fall behind.
With you here, I need not rush to evolve.
I curl a long limb around it.

lines.zh: 这点东西在我手里像沙
lines.en: In my grasp it feels like sand.
My long limb curls it up to the seams in my shell
I squeeze once, and it breaks.
I tuck it into a seam in my body.

lines.zh: 这不是海里该有的东西
lines.en: This is not something from the sea.
I close my grasp on it slowly.
If it is useful, keep it.
I drag it along with me.
Whose it was does not matter.
You are the one chosen.
The voice inside points at you.
I lower my head fully.

lines.zh: 四格高的躯体，压过来了
lines.en: A body four blocks tall bears down on you
Nothing else lives on this ground.
I do not need to chase at all.
My long limb is already out.
You are right before me.
Then let it begin here.
Do you hear the tide?
I lower my bulk.
All four sides are closed.
This is the seaborn's custom.
Beyond the trees, the tide is rising too
I have you locked in place.
The tide is rising.
I raise both forelimbs.
The moment is right here.
I turn with your direction.

lines.zh: 你跑到哪儿,我压到哪儿
lines.en: Wherever you run, my weight follows.

lines.zh: 长肢的影子先一步到墙角
lines.en: The shadow of my long limb reaches the corner first
Look back, and I am there.
I am not fast, but you cannot escape.
The tide closes in from all sides.
The voice inside counts the beats.

lines.zh: 你踩断的树枝我都听见了
lines.en: I heard every branch you broke.

lines.zh: 我压弯两棵树，堵住退路
lines.en: I bend two trees down to block your retreat
I narrow the ground, slowly.
Your back is against a tree.
I raise one long limb.
The tide keeps urging me on.
One more step is enough.
Your heartbeat is loud.
I wait for your first mistake.
I have flattened the trees.
There is nowhere left to hide.
Only a few steps remain.

lines.zh: 我停下来,只是为了让这一刻长一点
lines.en: I pause only to stretch this moment.
My long limb comes down.
The ground craters where I strike.
You are thrown into the air.
This blow leaves nothing back.
My bulk bears down on you.
Bones are cracking, and they are not yours.
I raise a forelimb and drop it.
Blood mixes into the wet mud.
You are still moving; good.
I step back to see the result.
This strike is the sea's will.
The tide will take the rest.
Your armour cannot hold back weight.
I add one more blow.
The ground sinks first.
I rise out of the collapse.
The whole grove is pressed into a clearing.
Seawater wells up through the soil.

lines.zh: 我直起身,头顶穿过树冠
lines.en: I straighten, my head above the canopy.
People in the distance look up.
Bones reassemble inside me.
I draw myself up straight.
This ground has become my road.
The tide-sound arrives before I do.
A string of snapping trees.
I settle, and dust billows up.
I scent dry land.
The seaborn needs a new road.
Then this road starts here.
I lower my head to this world.

lines.zh: 脚下的路是我压出来的
lines.en: I make my road by pressing it flat.
You should all stand aside.
The paths shift where I walk.
The tide climbs ashore behind me.
Fire rises, and my hide splits.
I collapse down from a height.

lines.zh: 我生在海里,却被水压住
lines.en: Born of the sea, yet the water pins me.
The blast tears a piece off me.
An arrow lodges in my joint.

lines.zh: 那股力量在推我回海里
lines.en: That force pushes me toward the sea.
What lives in me is eating me.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的躯体往下走
lines.en: Lightning travels down my body.
No sea here, and no ground.
